definitions: An international association football competition contested by the senior men's national teams of the members of the Fédération Internationale de Football Association (FIFA), the sport's global governing body.
The most prestigious association football tournament in the world, as well as the most widely viewed and followed single sporting event in the world.
examples: The FIFA World Cup is held every four years.
Many countries compete to host the FIFA World Cup.
Winning the FIFA World Cup is a dream for many footballers.
